## Dewey reads what you care about

### Connect all your sources

Point Dewey to your newsletters, podcasts, YouTube channels, X bookmarks, or anything else you care about. Dewey reads it 24/7 for you.

### Send links anytime

Found something you want read? Text it to Dewey and Dewey saves it.

### Remembered forever

Everything goes into Dewey's brain — searchable later, never lost in tabs.

## Your personal research companion

### Dewey keeps getting smarter

## Everything you care about, connected.

Dewey remembers what you read, notices the ideas that keep returning, and connects sources you would never think to put together.

## Everything on Dewey stays private, forever.

### Private to your account

Everything stored on Dewey is private to your account. Only you can see it.

### Never shared

Your data is never shared. Not with other users, not with anyone.

### Never trained on

We never train on your data. What Dewey reads for you stays yours.
